text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Canary deploy wave-214 -> runtime-prod-canary p99 latency spike and kernel fallbacks detected, paging eng-oncall.

sara_oncall: Ack, taking it. Pulling traces and logs now.

sara_oncall: Quick summary from metrics: kernel_fallback_count spiked, batch retries increased, p99 jumped. Snippet: 
```
kernel_fallback: 342 -> 512 (5m)
batch_retries: 12 (5m)
latency_p99: 420ms -> 1.8s
errors_5m: 0.6% -> 0.9%
```

mike_sre: tagging @jeremy_runtime — recent kernel-selector changes in canary?

jeremy_runtime: Yep, pushed kernel-selector v2 with adaptive_prefetch in last wave. Looking at selector logs now.

jeremy_runtime: I'm going to try two mitigations: 1) flip the feature gate for adaptive_prefetch off on canary, 2) if that doesn't cut it, revert kernel-selector to v1.

carla_support: Do we have customer impact counts? Support sees errors from ~8 active customers on the slow endpoints, 3 sessions timed out. Preparing comms draft.

sara_oncall: Mitigation plan (short):
- Pause new canary traffic
- Flip feature gate adaptive_prefetch -> off
- Start controlled revert if needed

sara_oncall: Pausing new canary traffic now:
```
redwoodctl traffic shift --route=canary --percent=0
```

jeremy_runtime: Flipped feature gate `adaptive_prefetch` -> `off` in canary cluster. running quick sanity.

jeremy_runtime: If flip doesn't stabilise within 3m I'll start revert:
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --id=wave-214 --target=runtime-kernel-selector:v1
```

mike_sre: Noted. I'm watching infra metrics and tail logs. Also bumping batch window to reduce micro-batching pressure as a temporary control.

ops-bot: Deploy job wave-214: revert initiated by jeremy_runtime, job id: job-5891.

sara_oncall: p99 trending down to ~650ms, kernel_fallback rate decreasing. batch_retries -> 3 in last 5m.

carla_support: Drafted status page: "We are investigating increased latency impacting a small subset of canary instances. Mitigations in progress." Will post with your OK.

paul_pm: Thanks for the quick action. Any ETA to full resolution / rollback completion?

mike_sre: Revert ~3/5 nodes completed, rest finishing. Expect stable signals in ~10m. I'll watch convoys and circuit breakers.

sara_oncall: Marking customer impact as low-to-moderate. No broad customer outage; limited timeouts on long-context requests.

sara_oncall: Handing off to @mike_sre for overnight watch. Criteria to re-open: p99 > 800ms sustained or errors > 1% for 5m. Adding notes to the incident thread.

mike_sre: Acknowledged. I'll keep alerts unmuted and escalate to jeremy_runtime if we see any re-emergence.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed by sara_oncall (post-mitigation watch). :white_check_mark:
